title: 导入格式示例：校园项目（3 词）

paragraphs.en: The reading room was often too noisy. Before making any changes, a group of students measured the noise near the door. They also asked readers when it was hardest to focus. The answers helped them understand the problem.
paragraphs.zh: 阅览室常常太吵。一组学生在采取改动之前，测量了门口附近的噪声。他们还询问读者，什么时间最难集中注意力。这些回答帮助他们了解问题。

sentences.en: The reading room was often too noisy.
Before making any changes, a group of students measured the noise near the door.
sentences.zh: 一组学生在采取改动之前，测量了门口附近的噪声。

sentences.en: They also asked readers when it was hardest to focus.
sentences.zh: 他们还询问读者，什么时间最难集中注意力。

sentences.en: The answers helped them understand the problem.
sentences.zh: 这些回答帮助他们了解问题。

paragraphs.en: The students suggested a practical solution: move group discussions to a separate room. This small change reduced noise in the reading room without stopping people from working together. After a week, more students said they could study there comfortably.
paragraphs.zh: 学生们提出了一个实用的办法：把小组讨论移到单独的房间。这一小小的改动减少了阅览室的噪声，同时又没有妨碍大家合作。一周后，更多学生表示，他们能在这里舒适地学习。

sentences.en: The students suggested a practical solution: move group discussions to a separate room.
sentences.zh: 学生们提出了一个实用的办法：把小组讨论移到单独的房间。

sentences.en: This small change reduced noise in the reading room without stopping people from working together.
sentences.zh: 这一小小的改动减少了阅览室的噪声，同时又没有妨碍大家合作。

sentences.en: After a week, more students said they could study there comfortably.
sentences.zh: 一周后，更多学生表示，他们能在这里舒适地学习。

questions.prompt: What did the students measure before making changes?

choices.text: The size of the reading room.
The cost of a separate room.

questions.explanation: 第一段明确说明，学生在采取改动之前测量了门口附近的噪声。

evidence.quote: Before making any changes, a group of students measured the noise near the door.

questions.prompt: How did the students reduce noise without stopping people from working together?

choices.text: They asked students to work alone.
They moved group discussions to a separate room.

questions.explanation: 学生把小组讨论移到单独的房间，既减少噪声，也保留了合作学习。

evidence.quote: The students suggested a practical solution: move group discussions to a separate room.

questions.prompt: What does “practical” in paragraph 2 most nearly mean?
questions.explanation: 这里的 practical 指能切实解决问题的、实用的，与词表规定的义项一致。

evidence.quote: This small change reduced noise in the reading room without stopping people from working together.
